items.q:
leaf  ·  flew  ·  branch  ·  climbed  ·  fell  ·  stream  ·  hunter

A dove was resting on a (1) ______ of a tree near a (2) ______. An ant (3) ______ into the stream and cried for help. The dove dropped a (4) ______ into the stream. The ant (5) ______ on the leaf and landed safely. Another day the ant saw a (6) ______ aiming at the dove. She quickly climbed up and bit the hunter’s hand. The dove (7) ______ away unhurt.
items.a: (1) branch, (2) stream, (3) fell, (4) leaf, (5) climbed, (6) hunter, (7) flew
